card.name: Words inside a repeated opioid warning
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "of" in "proper management of pain" in an opioid risk warning. It also fires weakly on scattered words such as "treated" after "Patients" in antiepileptic warnings.

modes.label: Management of pain
modes.description: The word "of" after "proper management" in a sentence about not withholding pain treatment despite abuse risks.
modes.example: The potential for these risks should not, however, prevent the proper management<< of>> pain in any given patient.
